answer: My strength is that I keep one name and answer for it. Every identity moors its collateral at a single jetty, and a prism at the gate reads each purse by its light: split one purse into ten masks and the prism shows ten bands of one colour, so all ten are lashed to one fate. If one mask cheats, the collateral of all ten burns together; kept apart, each mask must raise a full purse alone. Ten masks, ten purses, one voice. One sparrow, honestly kept, loses nothing by refusing the flock of masks.
